{"consolidated_memory":"Off-by-one day bug in ui/components/DatePicker.tsx (web UI side, TypeScript stack). Same symptom appeared twice but with different root causes:

OCCASION 1 [2026-02-20]:
- Affected: records carrying non-ASCII names only
- Signal: selected value one day behind the label
- Repro: pick the first of the month and reopen
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest (PR #4096 on branch fix/off-by-one-day-1)
- Result: reclaimed 11 GB of blob storage

OCCASION 2 [2026-03-06]:
- Affected: clients still pinned to v1 SDK
- Signal: selected value one day behind the label
- Repro: pick the first of the month and reopen
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter (PR #4807 on branch fix/off-by-one-day-2)
- Result: 50 duplicate rows a day stopped being written
- Test coverage: ui/components/DatePicker.test.tsx"}
